name: Birth of Henry VI
description: Henry VI is born in Windsor Castle, England.

name: Coronation of Henry VI
description: Henry VI is crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey.

name: Marriage of Henry VI
description: Henry VI marries Margaret of Anjou at Titchfield Abbey.

name: Beginning of the Wars of the Roses
description: The Wars of the Roses begin, a series of civil wars between the Houses of Lancaster and York.

name: Battle of Wakefield
description: The forces of Richard, Duke of York are defeated by the Lancastrians. Richard is killed in battle.

name: Battle of Towton
description: The largest and bloodiest battle of the Wars of the Roses takes place. The Yorkists defeat the Lancastrians, and Henry VI is deposed.

name: Readeption of Henry VI
description: Henry VI is briefly restored to the throne after the Battle of Edgecote Moor.

name: Capture and Imprisonment of Henry VI
description: Henry VI is captured in the aftermath of the Battle of Tewkesbury and imprisoned in the Tower of London.

name: Death of Henry VI
description: Henry VI dies while still imprisoned in the Tower of London.

name: Burial of Henry VI
description: Henry VI is buried at Chertsey Abbey, Surrey.
